set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm audit --json >/tmp/matrixhub-audit-v2.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/matrixhub-audit-v2.json'))
print('SUMMARY', json.dumps(d['metadata']['vulnerabilities'], sort_keys=True))
for name,v in sorted(d.get('vulnerabilities',{}).items()):
    if v.get('isDirect'):
        print('DIRECT', json.dumps({'name':name,'severity':v.get('severity'),'range':v.get('range'),'fixAvailable':v.get('fixAvailable'),'effects':v.get('effects')}, sort_keys=True))
print('ALL_NAMES', ' '.join(sorted(d.get('vulnerabilities',{}))))
PY
